content:
Prompt for one seamless continuous shot with a constant forward zoom and smooth acceleration to create an “infinite zoom” sequence with no cuts.

Use a single adult human figure only in the opening frames as a stable visual anchor, then remove characters for the rest of the zoom journey.

Structure the prompt with a timed beat sheet (e.g., 0–5s eye macro push-in → 5–10s apartment-to-city-to-Earth zoom → 10–15s galaxy/nebula-to-cell transition → 15–20s abstract tunnel → final futuristic city reveal) to control transformations across the clip.

Specify match-cut style transformations between scales (eye reflection → window → apartment → city → clouds → Earth → space → galaxy → nebula → star → cell membrane → landscape) to keep geometry coherent during impossible scale transitions.

Add quality constraints like photorealistic/ultra-realistic, cinematic depth of field, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, sharp detail, and explicitly include “no cartoon look,” “no text,” and “no dialogue” to avoid unwanted artifacts.

Prompt para una toma continua y fluida, con un zoom constante hacia adelante y una aceleración suave para crear una secuencia de “infinite zoom” sin cortes.

Usa una sola figura humana adulta únicamente en los fotogramas iniciales como ancla visual estable, y luego elimina a los personajes durante el resto del viaje de zoom.

Estructura el prompt con un beat sheet temporizado (por ejemplo, 0–5s eye macro push-in → 5–10s apartment-to-city-to-Earth zoom → 10–15s galaxy/nebula-to-cell transition → 15–20s abstract tunnel → final futuristic city reveal) para controlar las transformaciones a lo largo del clip.

Especifica transformaciones estilo match-cut entre escalas (eye reflection → window → apartment → city → clouds → Earth → space → galaxy → nebula → star → cell membrane → landscape) para mantener la geometría coherente durante transiciones de escala imposibles.

Añade restricciones de calidad como photorealistic/ultra-realistic, cinematic depth of field, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, sharp detail, e incluye explícitamente “no cartoon look”, “no text” y “no dialogue” para evitar artefactos no deseados.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Thread 1] Secuencia cinematográfica de infinite zoom ultra-realista, transformación visual alucinante, realismo VFX premium. Una sola toma continua y fluida, con un zoom constante hacia adelante, aceleración suave, match-cuts perfectos y transiciones de escala imposibles. Detalle nítido, profundidad cinematográfica, motion blur sutil, evolución de iluminación premium, surrealista pero fotorealista, no cartoon look.

Una figura humana adulta aparece solo al principio como ancla visual de partida. Después de eso, la secuencia se convierte en un viaje visual a través de entornos, estructuras y mundos. No dialogue.

La secuencia comienza en un apartamento moderno de ciudad, y luego se transforma a través de múltiples escalas y entornos: ojo humano, habitación, ciudad, nubes, Tierra, espacio, galaxia, nebulosa, mundo microscópico, estructuras tipo célula, túnel geométrico abstracto, y finalmente una nueva revelación de ciudad.
Ilusión perfecta de infinite zoom sin cortes, transiciones de escala coherentes, entornos fotorealistas, continuidad de macro a cósmico, transformaciones elegantes tipo match-cut, geometría estable, detalle VFX premium, flujo de cámara suave, visualmente viral, no cuts, no text.

0-5s: Extreme macro push-in Comienza con un primerísimo primer plano ultra cercano de un ojo humano. La cámara hace zoom hacia la pupila. Los reflejos dentro del ojo revelan una ventana, y luego toda la habitación del apartamento aparece dentro del iris mientras la cámara sigue avanzando.

5-10s: Continuous infinite zoom El apartamento se convierte en una manzana urbana vista desde arriba, luego en toda la ciudad, después en nubes y finalmente en la curvatura de la Tierra. El zoom continúa suavemente hacia el espacio exterior, con el planeta reduciéndose hasta convertirse en un campo de estrellas.

10-15s: Acceleration through cosmic scale La cámara atraviesa una galaxia espiral, luego una nebulosa luminosa, y después se sumerge en una estrella brillante que se transforma sin cortes en una estructura microscópica tipo célula. La membrana celular se convierte en un enorme paisaje circular.

15-20s: Final impossible reveal La cámara sigue avanzando a través de patrones cristalinos abstractos y túneles geométricos de luz, y luego emerge en una ciudad futurista completamente חדשה al amanecer, revelando que todo el viaje cósmico se ha resuelto en otro mundo. Termina con una revelación panorámica sobrecogedora.

Prompt pour un plan unique, continu et sans couture, avec un zoom avant constant et une accélération fluide afin de créer une séquence d’« infinite zoom » sans aucune coupe.

Utilisez une seule figure humaine adulte uniquement dans les premiers plans comme ancrage visuel stable, puis retirez les personnages pour le reste du voyage de zoom.

Structurez le prompt avec un beat sheet chronométré (par ex. 0–5 s : macro push-in sur l’œil → 5–10 s : zoom appartement → ville → Terre → 10–15 s : transition galaxie/nébuleuse → cellule → 15–20 s : tunnel abstrait → révélation finale d’une ville futuriste) afin de contrôler les transformations tout au long du clip.

Précisez des transformations de type match-cut entre les échelles (reflet de l’œil → fenêtre → appartement → ville → nuages → Terre → espace → galaxie → nébuleuse → étoile → membrane cellulaire → paysage) pour conserver une géométrie cohérente pendant les transitions d’échelle impossibles.

Ajoutez des contraintes de qualité comme photorealistic/ultra-realistic, cinematic depth of field, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, sharp detail, et incluez explicitement « no cartoon look », « no text » et « no dialogue » afin d’éviter les artefacts indésirables.

--- CONTINUATION DU THREAD ---
[Thread 1] Séquence cinématique ultra-réaliste d’infinite zoom, transformation visuelle à couper le souffle, réalisme VFX premium. Un seul plan continu et sans couture, avec un zoom avant constant, une accélération fluide, des match-cuts parfaits et des transitions d’échelle impossibles. Détails nets, profondeur cinématographique, léger motion blur, évolution premium de l’éclairage, surréaliste mais photoréaliste, no cartoon look.

Une figure humaine adulte apparaît uniquement au début comme ancrage visuel de départ. Ensuite, la séquence devient un voyage visuel à travers des environnements, des structures et des mondes. No dialogue.

La séquence commence dans un appartement moderne en ville, puis se transforme à travers plusieurs échelles et environnements : œil humain, pièce, ville, nuages, Terre, espace, galaxie, nébuleuse, monde microscopique, structures de type cellulaire, tunnel géométrique abstrait, puis révélation finale d’une nouvelle ville.
Illusion parfaite d’infinite zoom sans couture, transitions d’échelle cohérentes, environnements photoréalistes, continuité du macro au cosmique, transformations match élégantes, géométrie stable, détails VFX premium, mouvement de caméra fluide, visuellement viral, no cuts, no text.

0–5 s : Push-in macro extrême Commencez sur un gros plan ultra serré d’un œil humain. La caméra zoome dans la pupille. Les reflets dans l’œil révèlent une fenêtre, puis toute la pièce de l’appartement apparaît dans l’iris tandis que la caméra continue d’avancer.

5–10 s : Zoom infini continu L’appartement devient un pâté de maisons vu d’en haut, puis la ville entière, puis les nuages, puis la courbure de la Terre. Le zoom se poursuit en douceur dans l’espace, la planète se réduisant en un champ d’étoiles.

10–15 s : Accélération à travers l’échelle cosmique La caméra traverse une galaxie spirale, puis une nébuleuse lumineuse, puis plonge dans une étoile brillante qui se transforme sans rupture en une structure microscopique de type cellulaire. La membrane cellulaire devient un immense paysage circulaire.

15–20 s : Révélation finale impossible La caméra continue d’avancer à travers des motifs cristallins abstraits et des tunnels de lumière géométriques, puis émerge dans une toute nouvelle ville futuriste au lever du soleil, révélant que tout le voyage cosmique s’est résolu en un autre monde. Terminez sur une révélation grandiose à couper le souffle.

ja.content:
単一のシームレスな連続ショットで、一定の前方ズームと滑らかな加速により、カットなしの「infinite zoom」シーケンスを作るための prompt。

冒頭フレームでは、安定した視覚的アンカーとして成人の人間1人のみを使用し、その後のズームの旅ではキャラクターを排除する。

prompt は、タイム付きの beat sheet（例: 0–5s で eye の macro push-in → 5–10s で apartment-to-city-to-Earth zoom → 10–15s で galaxy/nebula-to-cell transition → 15–20s で abstract tunnel → 最後に futuristic city reveal）として構成し、クリップ全体の変化を制御する。

スケール間の変化を保つために、match-cut スタイルの変換（eye reflection → window → apartment → city → clouds → Earth → space → galaxy → nebula → star → cell membrane → landscape）を指定し、あり得ないスケール遷移でも幾何学的整合性を維持する。

さらに、photorealistic/ultra-realistic、cinematic depth of field、subtle motion blur、premium lighting evolution、sharp detail などの品質条件を追加し、不要なアーティファクトを避けるために “no cartoon look”, “no text”, “no dialogue” を明示的に含める。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---

One seamless continuous shot with a constant forward zoom, smooth acceleration, perfect match-cuts and impossible scale transitions. Sharp detail, cinematic depth, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, surreal but photorealistic, no cartoon look.

One adult human figure appears only at the beginning as the starting visual anchor. After that, the sequence becomes a visual journey through environments, structures and worlds. No dialogue.

The sequence begins in a modern city apartment, then transforms through multiple scales and environments: human eye, room, city, clouds, Earth, space, galaxy, nebula, microscopic world, cell-like structures, abstract geometric tunnel, then a final new city reveal.
Perfect seamless infinite zoom illusion, coherent scale transitions, photorealistic environments, macro-to-cosmic continuity, elegant match transformations, stable geometry, premium VFX detail, smooth camera flow, visually viral, no cuts, no text.

0-5s: Extreme macro push-in Start on an ultra close-up of a human eye. The camera zooms into the pupil. The reflections inside the eye reveal a window, then the entire apartment room appears inside the iris as the camera keeps pushing forward.

5-10s: Continuous infinite zoom The apartment becomes a city block seen from above, then the entire city, then clouds, then the curvature of Earth. The zoom continues smoothly into outer space, with the planet shrinking into a starfield.

10-15s: Acceleration through cosmic scale The camera passes through a spiral galaxy, then a glowing nebula, then dives into a bright star that transforms seamlessly into a microscopic cell-like structure. The cell membrane becomes a huge circular landscape.

15-20s: Final impossible reveal The camera continues forward through abstract crystalline patterns and geometric light tunnels, then emerges into a completely new futuristic city at sunrise, revealing that the entire cosmic journey has resolved into another world. End on a breathtaking wide reveal.

ko.content:
끊김 없는 하나의 연속 샷으로, 일정한 전진 줌과 부드러운 가속을 사용해 컷 없이 “무한 줌” 시퀀스를 만드는 prompt.

오프닝 프레임에서는 안정적인 시각적 앵커로 성인 인간 한 명만 사용하고, 이후 줌 여정의 나머지 구간에서는 캐릭터를 제거한다.

클립 전체의 변화를 제어하기 위해 타이밍이 지정된 beat sheet(예: 0–5초 눈 매크로 push-in → 5–10초 아파트→도시→지구 줌 → 10–15초 은하/성운→세포 전환 → 15–20초 추상 터널 → 최종 미래 도시 reveal) 형태로 prompt를 구성한다.

스케일 간 match-cut 스타일의 변환(눈의 반사 → 창문 → 아파트 → 도시 → 구름 → 지구 → 우주 → 은하 → 성운 → 별 → 세포막 → 풍경)을 명시해, 불가능한 스케일 전환에서도 기하학적 일관성을 유지한다.

photorealistic/ultra-realistic, cinematic depth of field, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, sharp detail 같은 품질 제약을 추가하고, 원치 않는 아티팩트를 피하기 위해 “no cartoon look”, “no text”, “no dialogue”를 명시적으로 포함한다.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Ultra-realistic infinite zoom cinematic sequence, mind-bending visual transformation, premium VFX realism. One seamless continuous shot with a constant forward zoom, smooth acceleration, perfect match-cuts and impossible scale transitions. Sharp detail, cinematic depth, subtle motion blur, premium lighting evolution, surreal but photorealistic, no cartoon look.

성인 인간 한 명은 시작 부분에만 등장하는 출발점 시각 앵커로 사용한다. 그 이후에는 시퀀스가 환경, 구조물, 세계를 가로지르는 시각적 여정으로 전개된다. No dialogue.

시퀀스는 현대적인 도시 아파트에서 시작해 여러 스케일과 환경을 거치며 변환된다: 인간의 눈, 방, 도시, 구름, 지구, 우주, 은하, 성운, 미시 세계, 세포 같은 구조, 추상적인 기하학 터널, 그리고 마지막의 새로운 도시 reveal.
완벽하게 매끄러운 infinite zoom 환상, 일관된 스케일 전환, photorealistic한 환경, 매크로에서 우주 규모까지 이어지는 연속성, 우아한 match 변환, 안정적인 기하 구조, 프리미엄 VFX 디테일, 부드러운 카메라 흐름, 바이럴하기 좋은 비주얼, no cuts, no text.

0-5초: 극단적인 매크로 push-in 초근접 인간의 눈에서 시작한다. 카메라는 동공 안으로 줌인한다. 눈 속 반사에는 창문이 보이고, 카메라가 계속 전진하면서 홍채 안에 아파트 방 전체가 나타난다.

5-10초: 연속적인 infinite zoom 아파트는 위에서 내려다본 도시 블록으로 변하고, 이어서 도시 전체, 그다음 구름, 그리고 지구의 곡률로 이어진다. 줌은 부드럽게 우주 공간으로 계속 진행되며, 행성은 별들로 가득한 장면 속으로 작아진다.

10-15초: 우주 스케일을 가로지르는 가속 카메라는 나선 은하를 지나고, 빛나는 성운을 통과한 뒤, 밝은 별 속으로 뛰어들어 그것이 미시적인 세포 같은 구조로 자연스럽게 변환된다. 세포막은 거대한 원형 풍경이 된다.

15-20초: 최종 불가능한 reveal 카메라는 추상적인 결정체 패턴과 기하학적 빛의 터널을 지나 계속 전진한 뒤, 일출 속 완전히 새로운 미래 도시로 나타난다. 전체 우주 여정이 또 다른 세계로 수렴되었음을 드러내며, 숨 막히는 와이드 reveal로 마무리한다.
